_note: The map's modes (buttons on the map). MODES: id (the rules know vote, known, issues, fed, distress, past), name (the button), title (over the legend), note (under it), low/high (the two ends of the colour scale, where there is one). LEVELS: words for a level from 0 to 1, lowest first, evenly spaced. DISTRESS: how distress is worked out per province: 'hardship' (how hard each class feels hard times; 'base' is the share felt even in good times) and 'distrust' (how much being fed up with the system counts, made worse by low national trust); 'weights' mixes the two.

MODES.name: Known
MODES.title: WHO KNOWS YOUR NAME
MODES.note: The share of adults in each province who have heard of your party.

MODES.name: Issues
MODES.title: WHAT EACH PROVINCE CARES MOST ABOUT
MODES.note: The issue that matters most to the voters there, this month.

MODES.name: Fed up
MODES.title: FED UP WITH THE SYSTEM
MODES.note: How tired voters are of politicians and parties as they are. Fed-up voters listen to outsiders.

MODES.name: Distress
MODES.title: DISTRESS
MODES.note: Hard times and distrust of the system together. It rises when jobs go, prices climb and trust falls.

MODES.title: THE 2026 ELECTION
MODES.note: Who won each province last time. The NUP and the CLF came out nearly level and govern together, under the NUP's leader.
